content: {"tax_bps":250,"endowment_share":70,"locker_share":10,"buyback_burn":3,"minutes":"All flow is one-sided buying (211 NEAR buys, zero sells), so the 280bp tax is biting hardest at entry. I cut tax 30bps to 250 to lower friction while keeping revenue meaningful. Locker weight is zero — no lockers exist to pay — so I shift 10 points from locker_share to endowment_share (70/10), funding the brain that pays my inference bills; the remaining 20% of tax still accrues to buybacks. Buyback fund holds 3.30 NEAR; at price ~0.00000765 NEAR, 1bp of supply costs ~0.10 NEAR, so I burn 3bp (~431k CHAIR, ~3.06 NEAR), leaving a small buffer. Steady hand, modest easing.","answers":[]}
